versions.content: Existence of reference to DiagnosticParameterElement in the role diagnosticParameter If the reference DiagnosticServiceDataMap- ping . diagnosticParameter exists, then the intention is to map a primitive (or com- posite) DataPrototype to a DiagnosticParameterElement in one piece. This means that the elements of the composite DataPrototype would not have to be placed one after the other starting at the bitOffset of the referenced Diagnostic- Parameter . Gaps are positively supported.
